$comment: Per-chain Merkl proof fixtures consumed by IntegrationFromConfigBase.fork.sol. Regenerated by script/test/refresh-integration-snapshot.sh on every bump — do not edit by hand. Each chain block holds parallel arrays (users/tokens/amounts/proofs) captured from the Merkl API at the time `accounts.json` was bumped, verified to match `Distributor.getMerkleRoot()` at the new forkBlock. The chain key is the chain id as a string. Empty/missing chain entries mean Merkl has no rewards for any tracked account on that chain (or proofs failed to verify and were skipped).
